Two different carts each want the single SOLO unit and are completed on different servers. The stock check and reservation happen under a process-local lock, so the two servers can both see stock available and both reserve, overselling SOLO (stock 1). The order_cart existence check runs inside the cart lock, but the lock is process-local. Two sequential or overlapping completes of the same cart on the two servers could each see no order_cart row and both create an order, which would link one cart to two orders. This is the same mechanism as attempt 1, tested with more copies to raise the chance of overlap.

adjustInventoryLevelsForReservations_ reads level.reserved_quantity in ensureInventoryLevels and then writes back an absolute value MathBN.add(level.reserved_quantity, adjustment) through inventoryLevelService_.update, with no atomic increment. When several carts sharing the WIDGET level are completed concurrently across two servers, two reservations can read the same base value and one increment is lost. The level's reserved_quantity then falls below the sum of live reservations, failing reserved_matches_reservations. Stock is 10 and the carts are small so oversell is not required to show the counter drift.
